output.summary: KEP-2441 proposes migrating kubernetes/kubernetes release-blocking and merge-blocking CI jobs from the deprecated Kubetest and scenarios tooling to kubetest2, starting with shadow canary jobs on the main/master branch only. The KEP is in provisional status at alpha stage.
output.rationale:
Kubetest and scenarios are deprecated and recommended to move to kubetest2, and kubetest lacks owners and active contribution. The proposal converges all release-blocking and merge-blocking jobs on one e2e launcher, reducing maintenance burden. It also accelerates moving off bootstrap.py and lets SIG Release deprecate push-build.sh.</rationale>
<parameter name="outcome_reason">null

alternatives.option: Continue using kubetest, scenarios, push-build.sh as-is
alternatives.why_not: Kubetest lacks proper owners and active contribution, scenarios are mostly legacy hacky scripts, and push-build.sh is being moved away from by SIG Release.
Kubetest lacks a good separation of concerns so changes have a large blast radius, most scenarios are obsolete, and push-build.sh in bash provides no value over the Go KREL push.

evidence.quote: Kubetest and scenarios have both been deprecated, for a while, with a recommendation to move jobs to kubetest2
Ensure all kubernetes/kubernetes release-blocking and merge-blocking jobs use the same e2e test tool, to reduce community maintenance burden
For the development (main/master) branch only, NOT the existing release branches: - Create shadow canary jobs for each
Kubetest lack proper owners and active contribution. Support is mostly added as bugs are discovered.
